007.why: Story 007, the 26 Oct 'on this day' comparison: Le Tissier (Southampton, 1996) v Totti (Roma, 2005), two famous chips over a goalkeeper on the same date. Paint without a reference: a split composition divided down the middle by a soft vertical watercolour bleed. Left half: an English footballer in a red-and-white vertically striped shirt and black shorts, seen from behind and slightly to the side, right foot just after scooping the ball, at a small, tightly packed 1990s English ground on an autumn afternoon. Right half: an Italian footballer in a deep crimson shirt with orange-yellow trim and white shorts, seen from behind and slightly to the side in the same pose, under the floodlights of a huge three-tiered stadium at night. In each half the ball loops high over a goalkeeper stranded off his line. Shirts with no numbers, no names, no badges, no sponsor and no lettering. Natural heads with short hair seen from behind, faces turned away.
